name: Cold load actual earned Security level6 and advancement counters

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local NPC=require('openmw.types').NPC
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local elapsed=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;if elapsed<.2 then return end;elapsed=0
 local security=NPC.stats.skills.security(self)
 print('VilverinContinue Security sample base='..security.base..' progress='..security.progress)
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died approaching authored iron gate')
 local gate=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x49bba))
 assert(gate and gate:isValid(),'Authored iron gate unavailable')
 local bounds=gate:getBoundingBox()
 local target=bounds.center-util.vector3(0,0,bounds.halfSize.z*.6)
 local delta=target-self.position
 local distance=math.sqrt(delta.x*delta.x+delta.y*delta.y)
 print('VilverinContinue gate geometry center='..tostring(target))
 local eye=camera.getPosition()
 local direction=camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5)):normalize()
 local ray=nearby.castRenderingRay(eye,eye+direction*145,{{ignore=self}})
 if ray.hitObject and ray.hitObject.id==gate.id then print('VilverinContinue gate focus confirmed') end
 print('VilverinContinue gate ray object='..tostring(ray.hitObject and ray.hitObject.id)..' distance='..tostring(ray.hitPos and (ray.hitPos-eye):length()))
 local p=camera.getViewTransform():apply(target)
 local yaw=math.atan2(p.x,-p.z)
 local pitch=-math.atan2(p.y,math.sqrt(p.x*p.x+p.z*p.z))
 print(string.format('VilverinContinue gate aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*64+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(pitch*64+.5)))))
 print('VilverinContinue gate first_person='..tostring(camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson))
 print('VilverinContinue gate sample pos='..tostring(self.position)..' distance='..distance..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 if distance<90 then print('VilverinContinue gate reached') end
end}}}}
